class.name: MobaMapPalette
class.brief_description: Materials and object scenes for the MOBA editor.
class.description: Assign reusable materials and PackedScenes through the Inspector. Object scenes need a Node3D root; static collision shapes participate in navigation. Palettes can be shared across maps.

method.name: create_defaults
method.description: Replaces the palette with grass, path and stone materials plus primitive tree and rock scenes.

method.name: get_material
method.description: Returns the indexed material; falls back to the first entry when the index is outside the palette, or null for an empty palette.

method.name: get_object
method.description: Returns the indexed object scene or null when outside the palette.

members.member: Up to 256 terrain materials. Cells store indices into this array.
Scenes available for placement and forest painting.
